{{Quote|Come, and I'll anoint you with the chanmasu herbs. Whether you believe in ritual or not, the scent will discourage your foe.|Chanya Medaal|<ref name="TOR:TDP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Devouring Plague|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''Chanmasu''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|herb]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and gave off a scent that discouraged [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] from attacking. The [[Order of Extermination]] anointed their members with the herbs during rituals in their efforts to eliminate the Killiks.<ref name="TOR:TDP" />
